{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}}{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Female}} [[High elf]] |boss={{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}} [[Dar'Khan Drathir]] }} '''Ruins of Silvermoon''' was a planned raid for Turtle WoW: Mysteries of Azeroth. They are the remains of the ancient and glorious capital of the High Elves, [[Silvermoon City]]. After being overrun by the Scourge during the Third War, only the Ruins remain in the wastelands of what was once Eversong Woods, now known as [[Eversong Wastes]].
